sections.Profile:
"Monte Carlo" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1987. It features a gambling and casino theme, with two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Notably, it includes a functional roulette wheel integrated into the gameplay. Designed by John Trudeau, with a production run of 4,315 units, the machine captures the essence of casino excitement.
